name: Multi-select
purpose: Several values from a list, shown as tags.
description: Select with several values as tags; open state shows a searchable checkbox list.
alternative: Textarea, Number input, Slider, Tags input, Phone input, Payment input, Verification code input and Multi-select are Figma-only: use a native element styled with Atomus tokens, or `Input`/`Select` where they fit.

do: Show the selected values as tags in the field.
Add search when there are more than about ten options.
dont: Don't use for more than ~15 options — add search (Combobox, coming next).
forbidden: Never use Multi-select when only one value is allowed — use Select.
